text:
maya: kicking off the 'market access entry card' for cloud listing uploads (AWS / GCP / Azure). goal: align legal, packaging, sku mapping, images, and creds. quick sync tmrw 10am PT. who can own pricing JSON + trial SKU?

sam: I can own pricing mapping + trial SKU. propose default trial=14d, introductory bundle SKUs for dev/startup tiers.

kai: I’ll take infra creds, staging buckets, and image pushes for GCP/Azure. need publisher account IDs and IAM roles from whoever owns that.

jurgen: legal checklist (high level): NDA present, marketplace contract signed, EULA localized, DPA if PII. vendor legal needs to sign marketplace addendum. ping @maya for doc link.

natalie: packaging note: we should surface two SKUs: "hosted-api" and "dedicated-reserved" (separate entitlements). doc screenshots, size limits, and quickstart link should be attached to listing.

maya: thanks — pulling together a short preflight in this thread. everyone, add blockers by EOD.

deploy-bot: created issue #MP-2218 for listing assets + #MP-2219 for pricing mapping.

maya: preliminary preflight (copyable):
```
- legal: marketplace addendum signed, EULA, DPA
- billing: pricing JSON, trial SKU, meter definitions
- assets: logos (SVG/PNG), hero image 1200x600, thumbnails
- images: docker image tags, container registry access
- infra: publisher account IDs, IAM roles, staging creds
- QA: test flows (purchase, trial activation, cancellation)
- telemetry: telemetry keys + retention settings
```

sam: timeline ask — target listing publish date?

maya: aiming for ~3 weeks from now assuming no legal blockers. that’s our soft target.

kai: question: do we need to provision separate egress allowances for Private offers? some clouds require a private-offer workflow.

sam: yes — Azure and AWS have private-offer flows; include that as an opt-in field in the PR. I’ll add notes to #MP-2218.

jurgen: estimated legal review cycle: 3–5 business days after we hand over the assembled docs. if vendor legal needs review, add 2–3 days.

natalie: designers: @anna (not in thread) will produce hero + icons; I’ll follow up with asset spec.

maya: action items: sam -> pricing JSON + trial SKU (due in 48h), kai -> staging creds + registry access (48h), jurgen -> confirm marketplace addendum template (72h), natalie -> asset spec + Quickstart stub (72h). I’ll schedule the 10am sync and send calendar invite.

sam: ack. will attach a sample pricing JSON to #MP-2219 by EOD.

kai: ack — need the publisher account ID from partnerships admin. @maya can you loop them in?

maya: looping in @partnerships-admin offline. also attaching initial cloud listing checklist doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/market-access/entry-card (will update after this thread).

jurgen: flag — if listing mentions data residency or special support tiers, we need explicit language in the EULA.

natalie: noted. will avoid specific residency claims until legal signs off.

maya: great progress. tiny ask: react with :thumbsup: once you’ve claimed your action item so I can track.

sam: :thumbsup:

kai: :thumbsup:

jurgen: :thumbsup:

natalie: :thumbsup:

maya: last note — if any partner wants a joint announcement, flag that now so comms can draft messaging in parallel.

sam: no announcement planned for initial listing, we’ll revisit on post-publish metrics.

maya: cool. see you all on the sync.
